notes.title: Love Colors: All DLCs discounted by 60%!
notes.content:
Hello pixel lovers,

Summer is here, and to Steam Summer Sale, [b]we've prepared a mighty 60% discount for all DLCs to Love Colors: Paint with Friends![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41155458/81d03d361f3942ba440a3564d1321e2f7be7a97b.gif[/img]

[h2]Happy Pixels:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569300/Love_Colors__Happy_Pixels/

Happy Pixels is the first DLC for Love Colors. It features a massive 130+ images from within 9 new categories. For those with a sweet tooth we have cakes, muffins and ice cream. Express yourself with fun emojis.

Become an expert in Entomology and paint mantises, ants and ladybugs. Head to the countryside to paint farmyard animals like cows, chickens and even an ostrich. Prepared to be spooked by bats, cauldrons and jack o'lanterns in the scary Halloween section. Feel festive painting presents, Christmas trees, Santa and other Christmassy scenes.

[h2]Pixel Adventurer:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569301/Love_Colors__Pixel_Adventurer/

Featuring an enormous 110+ images in 12 new categories. Go on a world tour and visit countries like China, India, Brazil and Canada. 

Paint majestic citiescapes, beautiful landscapes and iconic scenes like The Eiffel Tower, Sydney Opera House and more. Experience exotic wildlife such as elephants, pandas, parrots and we even threw in a few pugs because who doesn’t love a pug.

[h2]Pixel Seasons:[/h2]
100 new pictures to color on your own or with family and friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946730/Love_Colors__Pixel_Seasons/

Love Colors - Pixel Seasons contains:

• 39 Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter themes: colorful flowers, relaxing vibes, cozy places and others
• 9 toys to bring your childhood memories
• 12 mini art pieces, paper folded origami
• 10 different dinosaur species
• 10 entertaining circus performers
• 10 elements from countryside farm
• 10 mythical creatures and characters

[h2]Everyday Pixels:[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946731/Love_Colors__Everyday_Pixels/

Love Colors - Everyday Pixels contains:

 10 various vehicles: passenger cars, bus, bike, constructor truck and even country wagon!
• 11 symmetrical and vibrant Mandalas
• 10 pixelated masterpieces of Rembrandt, da Vinci, van Gogh and other artists 
• 10 steampunk themes (cat included)
• 10 musical essentials: instruments, singers and equipment
• 10 train related items: rails, wagons, languages and stations

If you wish to purchase all in one pack, there is an All-in-One bundle available, that will get you covered for all-year long mood with couple of hundreds of hand-crafted pixel art!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25391/All_in_One_Pack/

Happy coloring!

notes.title: Announcing Love Colors - paint by numbers pixel art with friends!
notes.content:
[h2]Wash-off your brushes, dust off your easel and get ready to channel your inner Bob Ross. Vixa Games is proud to announce Love Colors, the paint by numbers pixel art game is coming this fall.[/h2]

[h2]Like what you see? Add the game to your Wishlist![/h2]

[b]Promoting mindfulness through digital painting, Love Colors encourages logic and creativity as well as activating fine motor skills of accuracy and precision to create a meditative experience. A calming backdrop of soothing piano music will help to drown out your surroundings and keep your mind focused on completing your artwork.[/b]

[previewyoutube=Hp5ylIk2-vM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Pixels made together[/h2]
A wholesome experience, suitable for all ages, a wide range of canvas sizes and complexities means there's an image for everyone depending on their time and skill. Love Colors is easy to pick up, hard to put down and is a great way to unwind through creativity. 

Enjoyable solo but also when played with up to four people at the same time. Completing your artwork with friends or family encourages collaboration, communication and sharing joy in the sense of achievement of finishing your paintings. 

[h2]The tools you need[/h2]
Need a helping hand? Unlock two useful tools by progressing through paintings. The paint bucket which will fill-in all pixels connected of the same color; super helpful when taking on the larger paintings. 

Additionally the balloon will splatter paint of all colors covering a large area of the canvas, great for those intricate areas. When you finish your masterpiece, watch your creation come to life as your brushstrokes are replayed to you. 

The base game will be loaded with over 150 amazing pixel canvases from ten categories including funny sweet monsters, delicious food and drinks, stylish clothes and more. 

Unleash your true artistic colors, pick up your brush dab on some paint and become the Picasso of the Pixel! 

Love Colors is coming to Steam this fall! Keep following us for more updates regarding the launch date & more! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561060/
